"""Data models for Recursion (spec version 1.0.0)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass as _dataclass
from dataclasses import field as _field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, TypeAlias

from .._models import FileInput, JsonObject, JsonValue, Model, UarpEnum


@_dataclass(kw_only=True)
class Folder(Model):
    """Mutual recursion: a folder holds entries, an entry holds folders."""

    name: str

    leaves: Optional[List[Leaf]] = None


@_dataclass(kw_only=True)
class Leaf(Model):
    """The other half of the cycle."""

    title: str

    folders: Optional[List[Folder]] = None


@_dataclass(kw_only=True)
class Tree(Model):
    """A node that holds a list of itself — direct recursion."""

    label: str

    children: Optional[List[Tree]] = None


__all__ = [
    "Folder",
    "Leaf",
    "Tree",
]
